title: RRB Group D 28 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - General Intelligence and Reasoning - Direction and Distance
subject: General Intelligence and Reasoning

questions.q: Mr. Z starts from Point A and drives 18 km towards the North. He then takes a left turn, drives 14 km, then turns left and drives 14 km. He then takes a right turn, drives 13 km, then turns left and drives 25 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 34 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 21 km, and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only, unless specified.)
questions.explain:
Assuming Point A is the origin $(0,0)$.
1) 18 km North $\rightarrow (0, 18)$, facing North.
2) Left turn (West), 14 km $\rightarrow (-14, 18)$, facing West.
3) Left turn (South), 14 km $\rightarrow (-14, 4)$, facing South.
4) Right turn (West), 13 km $\rightarrow (-27, 4)$, facing West.
5) Left turn (South), 25 km $\rightarrow (-27, -21)$, facing South.
6) Left turn (East), 34 km $\rightarrow (-27+34, -21) = (7, -21)$, facing East.
7) Left turn (North), 21 km $\rightarrow (7, -21+21) = (7, 0)$, which is Point P.
Point P is 7 km East of Point A (0,0). To reach Point A, he must drive 7 km West from Point P.

questions.q: Karan starts from Point A and drives 12 km towards the North. He then takes a right turn, drives 6 km, then turns right and drives 16 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 8 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 4 km, and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only, unless specified.)
questions.explain:
Let Point A be $(0, 0)$.
1. Drives 12 km North $\rightarrow (0, 12)$, facing North.
2. Right turn (East) 6 km $\rightarrow (6, 12)$, facing East.
3. Right turn (South) 16 km $\rightarrow (6, 12 - 16) = (6, -4)$, facing South.
4. Right turn (West) 8 km $\rightarrow (6 - 8, -4) = (-2, -4)$, facing West.
5. Right turn (North) 4 km $\rightarrow (-2, -4 + 4) = (-2, 0)$, which is Point P.
Point P is at $(-2, 0)$. Point A is at $(0, 0)$.
To reach Point A from P, Karan must move from $X = -2$ to $X = 0$, which means driving 2 km towards the East.
